programs.title: Megatransporty 2
programs.desc: The team from Zamość undertakes to transport wind farms.The eight large-sized elements of each windmill are placed on a total of 17 sets.The route, which is over 1,200 km long, leads from Meyn in Germany to Jabłonowo Pomorski.Meanwhile, the company from Opole, in which the driver "Makuwa" works, undertakes the transport of a hundred-ton press for stamping metal elements.The team has to cover 220 km from the port of Świnoujście to Widzin, Kashubia.The third team is a company from Zabrze, waiting to load a huge forklift.The device can lift up to 45 tons.The cargo is to be delivered to the Czech town of Melnik near Prague.

programs.title: Supertruckers 3
programs.desc: The camera will visit employees of the Kings Heavy Haulage transport company, which operates in Bristol, England.The company has existed for over forty-five years.It is difficult to transport very large, problematic goods.Each new order is a real challenge for employees.Viewers will see how giant machines, vehicles or spare parts are transported - from loading onto trucks of similar size to delivery to the destination.All goods must reach customers intact.Truck drivers are still fighting against time.
